'''March 2001 Flatwoods tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Flatwoods, KY on 10 March 2001. It is known from Coleman Richardson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1869">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-flatwoods-ky-3-10-01d1869/ flatwoods-ky-3-10-01], DeckTech (Coleman "Crashman" Richardson, 11 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-flatwoods-ky-3-10-01d1869/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Flatwoods, KY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
